description: Live player counts from official public sources only: Epic's Fortnite Data API (all platforms), Jagex for OSRS (all platforms) and the Steam Web API (Steam players only, not the game's total). Each count has by, scope (total or steam_only) and as_of. Always say the source and scope when you quote a number; games without a legit count come back with the reason instead. Never estimate a missing count.

game.description: Optional game slug or name; leave out for every game
